findings.note: Glossary-form drift: 'Id duplicado' vs 23 es keys rendering the identifier token as 'ID' (only ui.hub.links.hub_id uses 'Id', pre-existing). Proposed 'ID duplicado'. Non-gating: meaning unaffected, consistency only.

'Bloqueo por política' is 20 chars vs EN 'Gate failed' 11 (+82%), the widest of the six class labels; names the outcome rather than the gate failing, which matches the sidecar role and uses the established 'política'. Wraps in an unconstrained text-meta

; flagged for a rendered check at the narrowest card width, no change proposed.
'Herramienta desconocida' 23 chars vs EN 12 (+92%); shortest faithful two-word label, no abbreviation licensed for user-facing copy. Wraps, no truncation, no change proposed.
90 chars vs EN 64 (+41%); two sentences as the sidecar requires, rendered in the wrapping state line (min-w-0), so no truncation. Recorded for the width column, no change proposed.

Branches are 6-8 words against the sidecar's 'Two to four words' (worst branch 39 chars vs EN 27, +44%). Accepted: the same note requires the line read as the family of state.failed_batch ('Falló el lote de vídeos.'), which Spanish needs the verb-initial form for; a 4-word fragment would break it. Recorded exception, no change proposed.

'Volver a los chats' 18 chars vs EN 13 (+38%) on a button in a flex flex-wrap row (canonical-transcript.tsx:7848), which wraps rather than clips; infinitive form is the style guide's rule for action labels. No change proposed.

'Audio saturado' folds EN's class label 'rate limited' into the same 'saturado' the paired sentence uses for 'busy'; internally consistent pair, but the 'you hit a limit' nuance reads as service saturation. No alternative es rendering exists in the catalogue to align with. No change proposed.
